about: Derived from the game's palettes, scenes, materials and texture lists by tools/build_paint_tables.py. Numbers are single precision: round each to it again. Palettes: base (66, null where unused) and legacy (the first ones, up to the last used), each how many colors it uses (0 none, 1 one, 2 four, 3 eight, 4 sixteen, 5 all) and the red, green and blue of its 64 colors. Lists: [whether unnamed layers are kept apart, layers], a layer [group, name, probability, whether it matches its base, options], an option [name, color alternative, palette, weight, use]. Materials: each one's lists for its two samplers (-1: none). Scenes: what each brings in, in order: a material (its index), a scene (-1 - its index), or what's built only with a part ([the part, items]). Models: the scene each one is (-1: nothing painted).
